acceptance_criteria: Cycle-accurate simulation matches the reference FIFO model for all sequences of writes, reads, simultaneous operations, overflow attempts, and underflow attempts over 1000 cycles.
The submitted module compiles with iverilog without errors.
The submitted module synthesizes with yosys without errors.
ground_truth: The design is a depth-4, width-8 FIFO with two-bit write and read pointers, a 3-bit occupancy counter, and registered read data output. Full flag is occupancy == 4, empty flag is occupancy == 0. Write increments write pointer and occupancy when write_en and not full. Read increments read pointer and decrements occupancy when read_en and not empty. read_data is the output of a register that samples the RAM output at the read pointer address.
